info.title: DiabetEasy API
info.description: Phase 1 backend replacing Base44: Sign in with Apple/Google, user-scoped health data, photo uploads, Claude AI tasks, FreeStyle Libre and Fitbit sync, account deletion. AI output supports, and never replaces, medical advice.

post.description: Apple form_post target for Android; responds 303 to the fixed App Link with fields in the fragment.
Verify a Sign in with Apple ID token, find/create/link the user and issue API tokens.
Verify a Google ID token, find/create/link the user and issue API tokens.
Issue a new access token from the refresh token (body on iOS, httpOnly cookie on the web).
End all sessions of the user: bumps token_version so every issued token stops working.

delete.description:
Delete the account in the designed order: (1) every stored file version under users/{id}/
(must succeed, otherwise 503 retryable and nothing else is deleted); (2) Fitbit revocation and
(3) Apple revocation, both best effort; (4) the user row, which cascades to all 10 tables.
